notes.title: Update v1.03 - Settings Hints & Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279339/cb88c218396f241c5bc4648e9fba31d20c9aa7f6.jpg

Changelog:

New Features:
- Hovering over some settings buttons now displays their functions

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a bug that skipped the dialogue with Ignetta when taking damage at the same time
- Fixed a menu bug that hid the settings buttons when hovering over the volume slider
- Fixed a bug with the disappearing health indicator texture
- Fixed a bug that caused players to get stuck under a platform in the Shining Dungeon
- Removed the chicken near the floating witch in the library, which caused a bug with picking up the lute

Other Graphical Changes:
- Updated the soda can texture on the main menu table
- Updated the flower texture in the pot on the main menu table
- Added a sketch to one of the notebook pages on the main menu table

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279339/60fcec7f5368e37da44d46d07056d81ec902e33a.jpg

notes.title: Update v1.02 - Mouse buttons for attack!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279339/88ee295729596315eb5dbc4f56997e7b7cc6381b.jpg

Changelog:

- Added the option to remap attack keys to mouse buttons in the settings
- Added new tips in the tutorial scene if you use the mouse for attack
- Fixed minor graphical bugs
- Fixed localization errors

Thank you for your feedback and suggestions! :)

notes.title: Update v1.01 - Hotfix and Hints
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279339/551775a6b5cf786bffd7550186518f714e188826.png

Changelog:

- Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash in one of the dungeons
- Now you can skip the dialogue before the final boss (after watching the scene once)
- Added an animation for the save point sign to make it more visually distinct from the background
- Fixed issues related to jump distance for bards and thieves
- Added new hints to the main menu

Thank you for your feedback and bug reports! :)
